subject: [Pine & Fork] Coupa login failing - SAML assertion mismatch
messages:
From: Olivia Hart <olivia.hart@pinefork.com>
To: chloe.martin@redwood.com; marissa.cole@redwood.com
Cc: it@pinefork.com
Date: Mon, 13 Sep 2027 08:15:00 -0700
Subject: Trouble logging into Coupa supplier portal - cannot accept PO

Hi Chloe / Marissa,

We received a PO from Redwood but our procurement team cannot sign into the Coupa supplier portal to acknowledge it. Every time they try the SSO flow they land on an error page that says "SAML assertion AudienceRestriction failed". I attached a screenshot of the error.

We pushed a test invite earlier today (invite email looked normal) but the users report a redirect back to our IdP with an error. Our IdP team says there may be a mismatch in the expected Audience/EntityID that Coupa is checking. Can you confirm the audience URL your tenant uses?

We need this resolved today because the PO has a short lead time.

Thanks,
Olivia Hart
Purchasing Manager
Pine & Fork Manufacturing
[attachment: screencap_login_error.png (image/png, 412KB)]

From: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.com>
To: Olivia Hart <olivia.hart@pinefork.com>
Cc: ben.carter@redwood.com, marissa.cole@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 13 Sep 2027 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Trouble logging into Coupa supplier portal - cannot accept PO

Hi Olivia — thanks for the details and the screenshot.

Quick checklist while we investigate:
- Can you send the full SAML response from your IdP (redacted is fine) or a debug log from the browser?
- Which email address are you using to accept the invite (some customers have separate corporate alias vs account email)?

From our side the Coupa tenant is configured to accept Audience = https://coupa.redwood-inference.com/saml/metadata and SP-entityID = urn:coupa:redwood:prod. It's possible your IdP is sending a different Audience or using the NameID in an unexpected format.

Ben — looping you in in case we should issue a manual portal account or send an alternate invite.

I'll stand by for the SAML response and logs. If you can paste the XML snippet showing the Audience or send sso-response.xml, that will help us repro.

Best,
Chloe Martin
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

From: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.com>
To: ben.carter@redwood.com, marissa.cole@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 13 Sep 2027 09:20:00 -0700
Subject: INTERNAL: Pine & Fork Coupa authn - likely Audience / NameID mismatch

Internal note — do not forward this message to the customer.

Summary: Pine & Fork hitting AudienceRestriction failure. They sent a screencap showing generic Coupa error. My read: their IdP is probably sending Audience = https://coupa.pinefork.com/sso/acs (tenant-bound) while our SP expects the canonical prod audience. Two options:

1) Re-issue a tenant-agnostic invite (use global SP endpoint) that accepts multiple Audience values — need platform config change, ops support.
2) Manual account activation by creating a provider-managed supplier account (short-term) and send credentials, then work with their IdP to fix mapping.

Recommended: option 2 as quick mitigation (we own the account creation), schedule follow-up with their IdP/IT to correct SAML Audience or add their ACS as allowed. Ben, can you provision a manual supplier record and create a one-time magic link? I can coordinate with Olivia on the onboarding steps.

Chloe

From: Olivia Hart <olivia.hart@pinefork.com>
To: chloe.martin@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2027 07:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Trouble logging into Coupa supplier portal - cannot accept PO

Hi Chloe — thanks for the quick reply. Attaching the SAML debug export our IdP produced when attempting the Coupa login (we redacted internal user attributes). You'll see the Audience element in the XML points to https://coupa.pinefork.com/sp/ACS which is tenant-specific.

We are currently using NameIDFormat = urn:oasis:names:tc:SAML:1.1:nameid-format:emailAddress with NameID = olivia.hart@pinefork.com. Our IdP team says adding the canonical audience (https://coupa.redwood-inference.com/saml/metadata) to the allowed audiences on their side is straightforward, but they'd like confirmation of the exact string to add.

Attached: sso-response.xml, sso-log.txt

Olivia

Hi Olivia — thanks for the SAML export, that makes the issue clear.

Plan of action:
- Short-term (within 1 hour): Ben will create a provider-managed supplier account for Pine & Fork and send a one-time secure magic link so your team can acknowledge the PO and download the invoice. That avoids the SSO flow while we fix the IdP mapping.
- Mid-term (1-2 business days): Please have your IdP admin add the accepted Audience/EntityID: "https://coupa.redwood-inference.com/saml/metadata" to the allowed audiences for the Pine & Fork SP entry, or configure an additional Audience mapping for tenant-specific ACS URLs.
- I'll open a follow-up ticket with our Platform team to support tenant-agnostic Audience acceptance as an engineering task; I will include the sso-response.xml sample you provided.

Ben — can you confirm once the manual supplier record and magic link are created and post the HubSpot deal note (linked below) with the link? I will update Pine & Fork after you confirm.
